verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs state that workflows can be triggered on schedules, as well as on record changes, manual actions and webhooks. These workflows can chain record operations, email, HTTP requests, custom code, branches, iterators, AI Agent steps and delays, so recurring automated workflows are clearly supported at the core. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule configuration (cron syntax, intervals, time zones), limits or reliability details for scheduled runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled triggers work in practice.
